rows.note: Use this for the act of bringing something into existence rather than the thing produced.

example.english: The creation of a better future takes all of us working together.
example.traditional: 我哋要一齊創造美好嘅未來。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jat1 cai4 cong3 zou6 mei5 hou2 ge3 mei6 loi4

rows.note: Use this for a concrete work, invention, or other thing that someone has made.

example.english: This creation is something I made from wood.
example.traditional: 呢件作品係我用木頭整嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 zok3 ban2 hai6 ngo5 jung6 muk6 tau4 zing2 ge3
